summary: Cango Inc. filed a Form 6-K announcing the appointment of Simon Ming Yeung Tang as CFO and director, effective April 22, 2026, replacing Chang-Wei Chiu (director) and Yongyi Zhang (CFO), who resigned for personal reasons. No financial terms or board recommendations are disclosed; the change is internal. The filing is a routine management transition under Rule 13a-16. As the departure is not forced/abrupt but framed as personal, this is a borderline case; however, given the direct announcement of a CFO/director change, it is classified as Management Changes. What to watch: any subsequent strategic shifts under new leadership.
